label: Big words
description: Words above the speaker's head. style 'pop' (default): big bold white words with a black outline, slightly tilted. style 'label': dark words on a white box, as written (a hook title or a picture's label). Uses params.text, or the spoken words of the anchor.

text.help: the words to show; default = the anchor's spoken words

size.help: font size as a fraction of frame width (shrinks to fit)
